value.title: Roméo et Juliette
value.snippet: Roméo et Juliette (French pronunciation: [ʁɔmeo e ʒyljɛt], Romeo and Juliet) is an opera in five acts by Charles Gounod to a French libretto by Jules Barbier

value.title: Roméo et Juliette (musical)
value.snippet: Roméo et Juliette: de la Haine à l'Amour is a French musical based on William Shakespeare's play Romeo and Juliet, with music and lyrics by Gérard Presgurvic

value.title: Roméo et Juliette (Berlioz)
value.snippet: Roméo et Juliette is a seven-movement symphonie dramatique for orchestra and three choruses, with vocal solos, by French composer Hector Berlioz. Émile

value.title: List of films based on Romeo and Juliet
value.snippet: Tresca. Juliet & Romeo (2025); a musical version of the story; directed by Timothy Scott Bogart (Italy/USA). Roméo et Juliette (1900); Romeo sings an aria
